author: Frankieeeee
body:
Age: 15, about to get 16

Timezone: GMT+1

Do you have Teamspeak? Yes

Do you have Discord? Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? I use OBS so yes.



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? I never was a moderated but i got a moderatorfriend on german servers who i help alot.


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating? My biggest weakness is probably that i get triggered after a long time playing but i wouldnt show that.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not? I think a leader has to keep the team together and has to know the strengths/weaknesss. I wouldnt consider myself as a leader, more as a right hand. I like to assist the leader but im not confident enough for that.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? Alot of people insult other players while im trying to help if needed. I dont blame others or anything like that.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? I think you need to know how to calm a situation and take criticism. I think i can do this.


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

Confidence

punctuality

active




CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do? I would tell that to a Sr. Mod or even an Admin. Also i would collect some evidence to prove that the mod is doing things wrong.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? Trying to calm them down and try to lead a respectful discussion.



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? Report that to a Sr. Mod again.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do? Report that to an Admin.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator? There are a lot of hackers and i hate playing with them so i want to ban them. I see a lot of disrespect to and i want to handle that too.


What does Avicus mean to you? Actually a lot. Like the community, atleast the most and i lke playing on there (competitive and public).


Anything specific the staff team could do better? Havent seen anything they made wrong yet. Probably some organizing stuff but i dont know.


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus? I play here the most and i want to have the server clean.


Do you have anything else to add to your application? Im very active and i think i would fit in in the staff team.
